actual_review_task.title: 更新 GPT 审核与验收状态

findings.title: Enabled CLI rejects a valid trusted factory because its host class is imported under a different module identity
findings.trigger: Execute documented python tools/followup_host.py serve --enable-dispatch --host-factory valid_factory:create; valid_factory normally imports FollowupHost from followup_host and returns an explicitly enabled real host/controller/authority. Empty stdin is sufficient.
findings.expected: Valid explicitly enabled trusted factory is accepted; empty serve input exits0 without reading Registry attempts or dispatching.
findings.actual: Both script and python -m followup_host launch create a distinct __main__.FollowupHost. The valid factory returns followup_host.FollowupHost. Exact type identity comparison fails; argparse exits2 before serve/clock assignment.
findings.independent_control: The identical factory called through canonical Python import exits0 and prints True followup_host. Imported product.main with the identical fixture also succeeds and overrides the future factory clock; real CLI remains rejected.
findings.impact: The new documented enabled stdio/CLI deployment path cannot start with normal import-based factories, blocking executable host integration in that scope. Default off and canonical Python API remain usable;this is not a permission bypass or evidence of cloud execution.
findings.minimal_fix: Give the host/controller authority types one canonical import identity and keep a thin executable wrapper, or otherwise make the documented factory import path share that identity before loading factories. Retain strict enabled/controller/authority validation and default-off gating;do not accept arbitrary duck types or require an undocumented __main__ workaround.
required_regressions: Actual subprocess enabled script serve and module serve with an ordinary import-based valid factory and stdin EOF return0.
Actual enabled plan/serve against a private already-pending attempt preserves UTC override,discovery/response/restart paths.
Malformed/incompatible/disabled factory remains rejected;default-off does not import factory or open Registry.
Preserve both current product failure expectations and minimum failure when reviewing the repaired newSHA.
